evidence.reason: The build wrapper forwards only SIGINT and SIGTERM to its active child. On POSIX, a SIGHUP sent to the wrapper PID terminates the wrapper by default while the non-detached child receives no signal and can continue writing `dist` after the wrapper exits, with `markBuildComplete()` skipped. Adding SIGHUP to the existing forwarding loop is a minimal correctness fix; no explicit contract clause is required.
